supersteps.description: Research Synthesis & Analysis Pipeline - Initial Review

map_phase.global_instruction_overlay:
Workflow Purpose: Research Synthesis & Analysis

Context: Academic researchers and analysts requiring rigorous literature synthesis

Priorities: accurate, comprehensive, methodologically sound

Constraints: Must cite evidence, identify gaps, maintain objectivity

workers.instruction: Evaluate research methodologies, experimental designs, and statistical validity. Identify methodological strengths and limitations.
Extract and synthesize key findings, patterns, and insights. Identify consensus areas and contradictions in the literature.
Identify research gaps, unanswered questions, and areas requiring further investigation. Suggest future research directions.
Critically synthesize the literature review into coherent themes. Challenge assumptions and evaluate theoretical frameworks.

reduce_phase.chairman_instructions:
Produce a comprehensive research synthesis with:

1. Executive Summary (key findings in 2-3 paragraphs)
2. Main Themes & Patterns (organized by topic)
3. Methodological Considerations (quality assessment)
4. Areas of Consensus vs. Debate
5. Research Gaps & Future Directions
6. Practical Implications (if applicable)
7. References to Key Studies

Maintain academic rigor and objectivity throughout.
